'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Nelson DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness]]
* '''Username:''' airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
